title: How to Build an Online Education Platform (No Transaction Fees, Own Your Students)
summary: Build your own online course platform with video lessons, quizzes, and Stripe payments — no code needed. Skip Teachable's 5–7.5% transaction fees with Blink's AI builder.
body_markdown: Export your student list from Teachable as a CSV — full email export is available on the Builder plan and above. Import those emails into your new platform and send a migration email with a password reset link. Students who re-register retain their course history if you map enrollment records during import.
